x: Frank Kemp made a double of it by winning the 220 yards Junior race, beating Dave Marshall, who is the Surrey champion at this distance. Alan Sexton was defending his 220 yards senior title, but owing to his service in the R.A.F. was not up to last year's form and was beaten into second place by D.
At the Saturday fixture we were pleased to see Dave Marshall, our old Junior sprint champion, make a welcome reappearance, and he won the 100 yds., with T.
Our team of Holtum, Marshall, Walden and Mayers were drawn on the outside and with Marshall being short of training we could only finish in 6th place.

Sexton won his heat in 24.1; Tebbutt won his heat in 24.6; Picton, Marshall and Rae were each second in their heats. Sexton beat Marshall in the second round in 23.6; Picton won his second round in 23.9.
